relationships.evidence_quote: Caspase-1 generates IL-1β from its precursor molecule pro-IL-1β by enzymatic decomposition.

relationships.subject: A-438079
relationships.evidence_quote: The intrathecal application of the P2X7R antagonist A-438079 suppressed the development of mechanical hypersensitivity in the hind-paw, ipsilateral to nerve damage.

relationships.subject: DRG satellite glial cells
relationships.evidence_quote: ATP released from dorsal root ganglion (DRG) neurons may activate P2X7 receptors at satellite cells, which in consequence release TNF-α potentiating P2X3R-mediated responses at nearby neurons

key_findings: Review: P2X7R on microglia/astrocytes drives NLRP3/caspase-1/IL-1β release and chronic pain; P2X7R antagonists relieve neuropathic and inflammatory pain.
